intro.text: A shy girl of eleven from a horned people, lost in Shadesmar and looked after by the historian Hwynn Tyvneri.

items.text: Lorieta can't name the world she comes from. Tyvneri, a historian from Rellam exploring the cosmere, found her adrift in the Cognitive Realm, resolved to help her get home, and looks after her like a parent while he searches.

appearance.text: Her people have horns, but hers are still small nubs. She speaks with a clipped accent, barely sounding her t's and d's.

items.text: In her dreams, Lorieta glimpses possible futures, though only to a limited degree. She had such dreams on her voyage with Tyvneri and Jasnah Kholin.
